summary: Herbalism is a gathering profession. Herbalists pick herbs from plants found across the world. Alchemy uses most of what herbalists gather. Forever adds herb seeds, which grow in a Greenhouse at a campsite, and new level 60 herbs.

nodes_contents_basis: Each herb node gives the herb of the same name; Mageroyal and Briarthorn can also give Swiftthistle, and Purple Lotus can give Wildvine. These are the Classic contents: the tooltip API does not list what a node contains, so they are not confirmed for Forever.

quest_objects_basis: Objects that need Herbalism but are not herb nodes: Classic quest objects, found by the same scan. Recorded for reference; they have no pages.
materials_note: Swiftthistle and Wildvine come as a bonus from other herbs. Where the new level 60 herbs and the scarce herbs grow has not been found yet.

camp.note: Incense Candle is the Herbalism camp feature itself (not a blueprint). The Greenhouse and Seed Hybridizer include its benefits.
camp.name: Incense Candle
camp.effect: Ignites an incense candle that allows you and others sitting nearby to gain

camp.name: Greenhouse
camp.effect: Places a Greenhouse that will grow herbs over time from seeds planted, and provides all of the benefits of an Incense Candle. Requires a Campfire nearby.

camp.name: Seed Hybridizer
camp.effect: Places a Seed Hybridizer that allows seeds to be multiplied or combined into rarer tiers, and provides all of the benefits of an Incense Candle. Requires a Campfire nearby.

other_items.name: Level 23 Herbalism Supplies
other_items.note: Contains the herbs a character would have gathered by level 23. Levels 38, 57 and 60 also exist (274690-274692); probably for boosted characters.

skill_up_rule: In Classic a herb is orange (always gives a skill point) until 25 points above its requirement, yellow until 50 above, green until 100 above, then grey. Not confirmed for Forever.

sources.name: Wowhead Forever tooltip API
sources.used_for: herb node names, required skill, main zone and spawn points (object IDs found by scanning ID ranges); herb, seed, blueprint and spell data

conflicts: Tomb Weed (object 694732, Tirisfal Glades, Herbalism 1) is treated as a new herb node, like the other new level 1 herbs in starting zones (Wilted Peacebloom and Stunted Silverleaf in Mulgore, Hyjal Silphium on Mount Hyjal). It could instead be a quest object like Tirisfal's Classic Gloom Weed and Doom Weed; the tooltip does not say.
gaps: The tooltip API maps only the zone with the most spawns of each node object. Other zones a herb grows in are not listed. The full zone lists are on the Wowhead object pages, which could not be read from this environment.
Node contents are the Classic ones and are not confirmed for Forever, including the bonus Swiftthistle and Wildvine.

No node was found for the new level 60 herbs (Demonsage, Death Lotus, Marefoil), for Cleansed Felbloom, or for the scarce herbs (Frilled Lichen, Rosecap, Stranglevine). They may come from objects outside the scanned ranges, from other sources, or only from seeds.
What the new starting-zone herbs (Wilted Peacebloom, Stunted Silverleaf, Hyjal Silphium, Tomb Weed) give is not known: no items with those names were found.
Stranglekelp object 618987 is new in Forever but has no spawn points on its tooltip.
How seeds drop, how long the Greenhouse takes, and what the Seed Hybridizer tiers give are not known yet.
Herbalism trainers and training costs are not covered.
